Frontend: landing loads, protected /dashboard redirects to /login, login with demo creds works, Add Transaction dialog creates txn (recent-txn count went 1->2), Reports page renders and AI insights returns headline+summary+tips.
passed: GET /api/accounts with cookie -> 200 with balance computed (55000 = 5000 opening + 50000 income)
Login form (data-testid) submits and lands on /dashboard
Add Transaction dialog: expense 250 created via dashboard-add-transaction-btn, recent-txn list grew from 1 -> 2
Reports page: get-ai-insights-btn triggers /api/ai/insights, ai-headline renders ('Aapka Financial Snapshot'), tips list rendered, monthly bar chart shown
notes: Deferred (not tested exhaustively in first-finish): currency switcher PATCH, account delete cascade, txn filters/search/delete on /transactions page, udhaar settle/remind/delete flows, data isolation across two users, register form UI end-to-end. Backend seed data already contained HDFC Savings account + 50000 income txn from prior smoke, so income stat came from that (verified via analytics summary and AI insights numbers).
